lines: I am trying to belong here. Please do not make that harder.
Fine. We can start again from here, but not from before.
I am still figuring out where I fit. Please do not make me fit around <dark_gray><wavy>fear</wavy></dark_gray>.
I hear the apology. The harm is still here too.
An honest effort matters, even if I am not ready to trust it.
Words return faster than trust does.
Give me space after this. Forgiveness is not the same as comfort.
I will watch what you do next, not what you promise now.
Regret is a start. Change is the part I need to see.
Some words cannot be taken back once everyone hears them.
I accept that you are trying.
Do not ask me to make you feel better about what happened.
We can be civil without pretending nothing changed.
I need time before this feels settled.
Thank you for saying it plainly.
I am willing to start over, but the pace is mine.
An apology begins the repair. It does not finish it.
I believe you are sorry. I am still hurt.
Let the next few days prove the words.
We can leave this here for now.
